architecture: Unchanged local24 SiLU plus trainable linear skip. Same fit-only exact-label calibration for all arms; no teacher coefficients supplied. Frozen arm is a no-training preservation control, not a new architecture.
objective: Same exact raw-log MSE/900 plus absolute opening MSE, paired minibatches and independent moments/clipping. Adam beta1=.9,beta2=.999, different epsilon or step only as registered. SGD no momentum or weight decay. FP32 model and gradients; FP64 exact labels constructed before cast for training.
selection: Common development score, earliest tie including0, freeze beforefresh. Primary preservation result is final checkpoint amplitude gates, also report selected checkpoint separately; do not hide deterioration by selecting0. Log gradient norms, update norms, and drift from initialization at all budgets.

hypotheses.claim: Adaptive normalization magnifies numerical-scale residual gradients near the exact solution.
hypotheses.contrast: Adam default versus SGD and frozen, with first-step gradients and parameter updates.

hypotheses.claim: A larger Adam denominator epsilon preserves the solution without reducing the base learning rate.
hypotheses.contrast: adam_large_eps versus adam_default, all else paired.

hypotheses.claim: The effective step magnitude alone explains deterioration.
hypotheses.contrast: adam_small_step versus adam_default; compare with epsilon intervention.

cost.scope: Packed15 static models, not a matched deployment speedup benchmark.

limitations: Static full-state readout only. Fit calibration is not SGD discovery. Optimizer epsilon changes optimization, not evaluation thresholds. No claim of temporal/closed-loop correctness or recurrent compression.
